observations: Front view shows a white Hisense microwave oven with a black glass door.
A sticker on the door glass identifies the model as H20MOWS14 with a 20L capacity.
The control panel features two mechanical knobs for power/temperature and a 35-minute timer.
Interior view shows a clean cavity and a glass turntable plate.
Side view shows the white metal casing and a power cord with a 3-pin plug.
The protective marketing sticker is still attached to the front glass.

claims.claim: Bought brand new and neatly used

claims.evidence: The carton and additional accessories are not shown in any of the photos.

risks.risk: Magnetron may be defective (unit does not heat)
risks.proof: A video clip showing the microwave heating a cup of water to boiling point.
A video showing the glass plate rotating while the unit is running.
A photo showing the unit next to its original box and documentation.

proof_requests: Video of the microwave in operation heating a cup of water and showing the turntable rotating.
Photo of the original carton and any included accessories/manuals.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly visible, allowing for a valuation based on the worst-case functional state (not heating).
